title: Badami Chalukya art and the Vesara style
quote: Badami (rock-cut) → Aihole (experimental) → Pattadakal (mature) = birth of Vesara

boxes.title: Three phases of Chalukya art
steps: **Aihole**: experimental / early temples - =="Cradle of Indian temple architecture"== (K.A. Nilakanta Sastri)
**Pattadakal**: mature - Nagara and Dravida side by side
